folder: docs/Robot HAT 3D Renders and Images/ (the owner's local evidence folder; untracked, never copied)
policy: Hashes, counts, pixel sizes, depth-map presence and 35 mm focal length only. No pixels, no other EXIF (no capture time, location or device serial), no absolute paths.

aggregate.method: SHA-256 over the sorted lines '<sha256>  <path relative to the folder>\n'

countNote: Exactly 609 photographs (HEIC). The folder also holds the two USDZ scans and two 700 x 932 JPEG references. No GLB, GLTF, OBJ, PLY or STL is present.
orientation: 502 frames are portrait 3024 x 4032 and 107 landscape 4032 x 3024 after the HEIC transform; every EXIF orientation tag reads 1
classMethod: SIFT registration of each frame to two owner frames rectified on the four datum bores (PIC_0001 top, IMG_0004 underside), chained through sequence neighbours; tilt and camera position from the plane homography and the 35 mm focal length; close-ups are frames above 60 px/mm at the board; a low-angle frame is named by the board edge facing the camera

edges.south: y = 0: USB-C, ADC and PWM 0-3 labels, cable slot
edges.west: x = 0: battery, power switch, buttons, I2C

Robot HAT Top.usdz.content: Object Capture baked mesh, 32107 vertices, 64203 faces, with colour, normal, roughness, AO and displacement maps
Robot HAT Top.usdz.registration: board plane by RANSAC (9945 inliers), then a similarity onto the four datum bores: scale 1.0345, 0.21 mm RMS

Robot HAT Bottom.usdz.content: Object Capture baked mesh, 25376 vertices, 50748 faces, with colour, normal, roughness, AO and displacement maps
Robot HAT Bottom.usdz.registration: board plane by RANSAC (7792 inliers), then a reflected similarity onto the four datum bores: scale 1.0200, 0.14 mm RMS

featureEvidence.feature: PCB outline, corners, cable slot, J20 notch

featureEvidence.check: silkscreen rings concentric with the bores in PIC_0001 and IMG_0097; scan bores 0.14 to 0.21 mm RMS

featureEvidence.feature: GPIO pad field and underside socket
featureEvidence.check: 40 of 40 pads within 0.32 mm of the 2.54 mm lattice

featureEvidence.feature: Servo banks, SPI/I2C and UART headers (pins, colours, labels)
Motor, battery, I2C, speaker and USB-C connectors

featureEvidence.check: larger parts confirmed by scan height; 0603 parts are below the scan resolution

featureEvidence.feature: Silkscreen and board identity (Robot Hat V4, 01902V44, SunFounder branding)

files.note: lowest-sharpness frame (hand or edge in the foreground; board still legible at thumbnail scale); kept, not used for measurement
